name: quick
description: Single-task feature pipeline for 1-3 file changes. Plan → tasks-for-sonnet placement + in-place plan shaping → optional Codex review → subagent-driven-development → done. No worktree, no harness, no Validation Contract. Routes to /go when boundary triggers (money / auth / migration / >5 files / client-trust / schema / state-drift / provider-reliability / PII / lifecycle / live-runtime-path) fire. Hard dependency on obra/superpowers. Project-agnostic.
